allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

apis.description: Array of API interface contracts defining endpoints, protocols, and security requirements.

items.description: A single API contract with path, method, parameters, security, and traceability.

api_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this API (e.g., 'api-session-create').

name.description: Human-readable name of this API endpoint.

version.description: API version string in vN or vN.N format (e.g., 'v1', 'v2.1').

protocol.description: Communication protocol for this API: http, grpc, ws (WebSocket), or mqtt.

path.description: URL path for this API endpoint (e.g., '/api/v1/sessions').

method.description: HTTP method for this endpoint: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

input_schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON Schema defining the request body structure.

output_schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON Schema defining the response body structure.

errors.description: Array of error states that this API may return.

items.description: An error state that this API may return.

parameters.description: Array of parameters accepted by this API endpoint.

items.description: A single API parameter with its name, location, and whether it is required.

name.description: Name of the parameter as it appears in the request.

in.description: Where the parameter is located: query string, URL path, or request header.

required.description: Whether this parameter must be provided in the request.

schema.description: Reference to the schema type for this parameter value.

example_refs.description: References to example request/response pairs for this API.

security.description: Authentication/authorization mechanism for this API: none, api-key, oauth2, jwt, or mTLS.

owner.description: Team or domain responsible for this API.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream functional requirements or capabilities.

items.description: A traceability reference for this API contract.

interface_ref.description: Canonical reference linking this API to the canonical interface registry.

event_ref.description: Canonical reference to events emitted or consumed by this API.

entity_ref.description: Canonical reference to the primary entity this API operates on.

policy_ref.description: Canonical reference to the access or governance policy for this API.

enum_provenance.description: Provenance tracking for externally-sourced enums in this API.

source_url.description: URL of the external source where the enum values originate.

source_date.description: Date when the enum values were retrieved from the source.

resolved_version.description: Version of the external source used to resolve enum values.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the enum values were resolved.

resolver.description: Tool or person that resolved the enum values.
